rules: Use tracking-tight for all headings above 32px.
Overlines/labels must be Uppercase, text-xs, tracking-[0.2em].
Do not use generic 'Bold' for headers by default; utilize font-light or font-black for tension.
Never exceed text-6xl for maximum heading sizes.
Never use pure black (#000000) or pure grey. Always tint with blue (e.g., slate-950).
Gradients are prohibited for backgrounds; use solid, flat colors.
Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast for normal text and 3:1 for large text.
ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover. Example: hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white.

layouts.spacing_scale: Use generous padding: p-4, p-6, p-8. Containers with borders must have internal padding.
rules: Grid items must be direct children of the grid container.
Override stretch behavior with align-items: start where necessary, stretch individual items.
Sidebar must remain persistent and structured cleanly.

surfaces: Dashboard Cards: Flat solid background (bg-slate-900), sharp 1px border (border-white/10), NO generic soft shadows.
Header/Sticky Elements: If content scrolls underneath, use Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-950/70) with a 1px delicate inner stroke. NEVER fully transparent.
Webcam Preview Frame: Apply subtle retro-futurism (scanlines or 4-corner targeting brackets) to simulate AI face recognition.
Dropzone: 1px dashed border with hover glow (e.g., hover:border-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-500/5).

components.general: Prioritize customized Shadcn UI primitives over generic HTML elements.
components.cards: Go cardless or use strictly rectangular, dense, flat styles. Avoid excessive rounded corners (max 8px radius).
components.tables: Use Shadcn Table. Left-align text content, right-align numerical metrics. Use the 'Grid Borders' look for technical precision.
components.charts: Use Recharts wrapped in Shadcn Chart patterns. Use vibrant, thin lines for data representation that contrasts well against dark surfaces.
components.chatbot: Do not use standard SMS bubbles. Use sleek, brutalist rectangular blocks with muted backgrounds for bot, and primary accent border for user.
components.badges: For sentiment (Positive/Negative/Neutral), use subtle flat backgrounds with high-contrast text and 1px borders.

rules: Implement micro-interactions on all hover, click, and focus states.
Use specific transitions (e.g., transition-transform duration-200, transition-colors), NEVER use 'transition-all'.
Stagger entrance animations for lists (customer history, recent activity).

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, menus, error messages) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='upload-image-dropzone').
accessibility.focus: Focus states must have HIGHER contrast than default, utilizing rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-rose-500 focus:outline-none).

instructions_to_main_agent: Load and apply Outfit and Manrope fonts in your CSS.
Build a persistent left sidebar with the 5 modules.
Implement the 'Unified Dashboard' as the default view, displaying stats, Recharts donut/line charts, and a recent activity feed.
For Face Recognition, use a simulated live webcam feed with the 'customer_faces' images and an AI bounding box/overlay with the customer's name.
For the FAQ Chatbot, implement a sleek chat UI avoiding native SMS styling.
For Product Classifier, create an aesthetic drag-and-drop zone using the 'retail_products' images as classification history.
Ensure the UI uses the dark slate palette (bg-slate-950) with the primary accent (#F43F5E) used sparingly for core CTAs and active states.
Never apply transition-all in tailwind classes. Use specific transitions.
Ensure NO pure transparent backgrounds exist over interactive content; always apply appropriate solid colors or blur overlays.
Every interactive or critical element must have a 'data-testid'.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create distinctive frontends that surprise and delight. Avoid generic AI slop.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, preferring flat surfaces and 1px borders over soft muddy shadows.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur, never fully transparent without blur) for overlapping elements like sticky headers.
Do NOT apply universal transition (transition-all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
Do NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Use modern button styles (sharp or subtle roundness max 8px) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use generous spacing (2-3x more than usual) to give elements room to breathe.
Incorporate subtle grain textures, custom selection states, and thoughtful loading states.
